title: Server-side Meta SAM video processing
description: Implement the bounded same-origin video route, actual-byte validation, MP4-only temporary Meta upload after local normalization, streamed SAM segmentation parsing, FFmpeg derivation of hash-verified candidate and 1 fps context stills during stage=segment, bounded JPEGs in a one-time in-memory lease, identity/token-only stage=map without a duplicate phone upload, optional Baseten Muse fallback, sanitized response, timeout, and cancellation behavior.
rationale: The Meta video path is provider- and format-sensitive; keep credentials, provider bodies, file IDs, and media out of browser state and logs.
acceptance: Unsupported container/codec, bad bytes, oversized/overlong media, extra prompts, and stale identity fail closed before provider processing; validated MOV reaches this route only as normalized MP4.
SAM events are parsed with the official parser and only sanitized frame references reach the client.

FFmpeg derives candidate and signed 1 fps context JPEGs from the hash-verified segment upload and caches them under the one-time bounded lease; map accepts only identity and token and rejects client-supplied still/video bytes.
Muse receives only the server-leased stills and context; output is strict-schema validated against current elements and source-frame references.
Missing FFmpeg or unsupported source-frame decoding fails closed before Muse; deployment uses ffmpeg from PATH or server-only FFMPEG_PATH.
Optional Baseten fallback runs only after an eligible Meta Muse provider failure, never after setup, validation, safety, or output-schema failures.
Provider failures never silently fall back to fixture output or expose raw bodies/keys/file IDs.
